name: What should I do first if I need a partition wall framed quickly?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I need a partition wall framed quickly?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you already have a tight move-in date, the fastest path is to confirm the wall layout, open items, and finish scope before materials are ordered. Delays usually come from hidden wiring, uneven floors, or late design changes, not from the framing itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Confirm the layout, check for hidden utilities, and lock in the finish scope before ordering materials. Most delays come from surprises after the wall is opened up.
